foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat filing fee of $180.00 for the Foreign Registration Statement; expedited and same-day service add fees.
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an annual report yearly, due by the business's expiration date (the last day of the month in which the business was first registered), and maintain a registered agent with a physical Washington address.

evidence.quote: Foreign Registration Statement - Profit Entity Types (PDF Fillable Form) Required Filing fees $180
Foreign Registration Statement – Profit types Washington Secretary of State

An Annual Report is due by the business entity’s expiration date, which is the last day of the month in which the business was first formed/registered with our office; and can be filed up to 180 days before the expiration date.
This role is required by law for both domestic entities and registered foreign entities operating in Washington State.

notes: The $180 fee is the registration fee only; the annual report is a separate recurring filing with its own fee. Expedited and same-day service add fees.
